answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. Work waits on the ivory until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the nadir of the next round. Reaching the lagoon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake.
